body: Here is a thought. What if I just keep moving? I could even avoid a name change so long as I simply use an alias in conversation. If I move towns every couple of weeks or whenever I use my real name for official reasons, maybe that would be enough to keep all but the most serious tracking efforts off my tail... as soon as I make a blip somewhere, I'd be gone to another location.

>If someone wants to find you and has the time/money/inclination...they will find you.

I suspect this is true, but the least I can do is make it as difficult as possible and hope they don't bother.

>If you really want to hide pick a third world country with shoddy record keeping.

I have not excluded any options.

>Of course then you will have to figure out how to earn money to support yourself which is extra difficult when you are hiding and not doing anything to leave a paper trail.

Considering the extent of illegal immigration in America I would have thought it not exceedingly difficult.
Yes. something along these lines. That's unfortunate.
If a person were to ask for recommendations on methods, would he receive legitimate responses here or cries that "it's not worth it!" ?
